_comment: Jellyfin accounts managed by ./configure.sh. Copy to jellyfin-users.json (gitignored: it names
your family) and edit. One object per user; this first object is documentation and is ignored.
name       the Jellyfin user name (created when missing, without a password)
role       admin | adult | child. admin: every library, every right. adult: may not delete
media or control other people's players. child: as adult, plus a parental rating
cap, unrated items blocked, no SyncPlay.
rating     maximum parental rating for a child (12, 9, ...)
libraries  list of library names as shown in Jellyfin, or the string "all"
livetv     may watch Live TV                                   (default false)
channels   may open plugin channels, e.g. what the Live TV plugin publishes (default false)
hidden     not shown on the login screen                       (default false)
nopass     signs in without a password; one set in the UI is removed again (default false;
not possible for an admin, Jellyfin refuses it)
rich       backdrops, theme media, details banner, next-episode overlay, episode stills,
Collections view, set on every run                   (default false)
audio      preferred audio language, ISO 639-2 (nld, eng): that track plays when present
subtitles  preferred subtitle language; when set, subtitles are always shown
Rights and preferences are re-applied on every run, so edit them here, not in the UI.
Users that exist in Jellyfin but not here are left alone, never deleted.
